data.name: Improved Snap Shot
data.description: At the end of your turn, you can spend 5 stamina points to threaten an additional 15 feet with Snap ShotAPG (instead of an additional 10 feet) until you take an attack of opportunity against an opponent in the expanded threat range or the beginning of your next turn, whichever comes first.
